title: Blue Ursus
synopsis: Ready to fight! Only bad girls would go to Gokumon Girls' High School. A big girl, Amaki Seina, over 180cm tall, enrolls in this rough school full of delinquents. With her extraordinary physique, she uses professional wrestling moves to defeat the delinquents one after another! What's more, she uploads clips of the fights to a video site...? What is the "personal goal" she is pursuing by picking fights with delinquents?! (Source: Manga One, translated)

title: What's Wrong with Secretary Kim?
synonyms: ¿Qué le pasa a la secretaria Kim?
Qu'est-ce qui cloche avec la secrétaire Kim ?
Was ist los mit Sekretärin Kim?
synopsis: Vice Chairman Youngjun Lee and Secretary Miso Kim have been the star duo of their company for nine years... until Miso suddenly decides to quit! But Youngjun is smart, rich, and used to getting what he wants — and he wants Miso to stay. So when he discovers she’s leaving in order to find a husband, the only logical way to keep her at his side is... offering to marry her?! Too bad she’s just not that into him! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Kurokouchi
synopsis: Kurokouchi Keita is the black sheep of the police force. He works alone, and doesn't think twice about extorting money from the dirty politicians by getting hold of their achilles heels. Using the money and whatever bits of information acquired through underhanded means, he gets closer and closer to the ultimate unresolved crime of the Showa era (1968); the 300 million bank heist. One day, the new rookie Seike Shingo, is assigned as Kurokouchi's partner. Excellent, but naive and idealistic, he is the exact opposite of Kurokouchi, but nonetheless, the duo relentlessly chase down criminals.

title: Toaru Anbu no ITEM
titleNative: とある暗部の少女共棲
synopsis: The Academy City, where the pinnacle of science and technology converges to advance psychic development. But behind the seemingly peaceful and glamorous facade of this city lurks a “dark side.” The girls known by the codename “ITEM” are a part of this world. They form an elite unit composed of specialists in various fields, led by the Level 5 esper, Shizuri Mugino. When a new member joins “ITEM,” she will find herself drawn into a conspiracy lurking beneath the city's surface... (Source: Dengeki Daioh, translated)

title: Reincarnated as a Neglected Noble: Raising My Baby Brother With Memories From My Past Life
titleRomaji: Shirobuta Kizoku desu ga Zense no Kioku ga Haeta node Hiyoko na Otouto Sodatemasu @COMIC
titleEnglish: Reincarnated as a Neglected Noble: Raising My Baby Brother With Memories From My Past Life
titleNative: 白豚貴族ですが前世の記憶が生えたのでひよこな弟育てます@COMIC
synopsis: An empire falling to ruin: The Kio Empire. Living in that empire, is an overweight 5-year-old abandoned by his parents, Prince Ageha. Ageha has memories from a previous life of him living as a Japanese man in another world. He then encounters his younger half-brother, Regulus. Ageha had a vision that Regulus will kill him in the future over inheritance, so Ageha sets out to raise him after Regulus's mother passed. Once the sparkling and fluffy-haired Regulus cozied up to Ageha, He turned into a doting older brother before he even realized! Enjoy a fantasy story of young brothers managing their kingdom, sometimes involving the gods, as they reform it step by step to bring a better land to the next generation! (Source: MangaPlaza)
